Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com

Subject: Discovery follow-up: Redwood demo + VP/CTO intro to unblock next steps

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier — really appreciated the context on Acme Health's ingestion timelines and the two big priorities you emphasized: (1) reducing inference costs while keeping response latencies within SLA, and (2) ensuring strict data isolation and auditability for PHI workflows.

Quick recap from our side:
- Current environment: batch + low-latency endpoints; 3–5M inference calls/month.
- Primary drivers: lower per-token spend, predictable tail latency for the clinical app, and SOC2 / audit log readiness.
- Success criteria you outlined: 40% reduction in inference cost per month OR consistent 50–150ms p50 for the clinical path; audit logs and contract-level data locality.

Next steps we discussed:
1) Technical deep dive (45–60m) with our solutions engineer to go over architecture, batching/kv-cache approach, and network/topology options for private deployments.
2) Executive alignment call (20–30m) to introduce your VP/CTO and our CTO (Vivek Kulkarni) to align on compliance/SLA expectations and commercial timeline.

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Tue May 9, 10:00–11:00am PT (technical deep dive + Vivek available at start)
- Wed May 10, 2:00–3:00pm PT (technical deep dive)
- Thu May 11, 9:00–9:30am PT (short exec intro)

I've attached a short one-pager that summarizes Redwood's Dedicated and Private options for regulated workloads (redwood-onepager.pdf).

If any of those times work, I'll lock the invites and loop in Vivek and Ethan (our solutions engineer) for the technical session. If you'd like, we can do a combined session with both tech + execs on May 9 — we find that accelerates decisions when the CTO can hear the architecture tradeoffs directly.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
